entries.title: I Samuel 3:1
segments: And the child Samuel served the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days. [There was] no open vision.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:2
segments: And it happened at that time, when Eli [was] lying down in his place, and his eyes began to become dim so that he could not see.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:3
segments: And the lamp of God had not gone out. And Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God [was].

entries.title: I Samuel 3:4
segments: And the LORD called Samuel. And he answered, Here [am] I.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:5
segments: And he ran to Eli, and said, Here [am] I. For you called me. And he said, I did not call. Go and lie down again. And he went to lie down.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:6
segments: And the LORD called again, Samuel! And Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, Here [am] I, for you called me. And he answered, I did not call, my son. Go back, lie down.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:7
segments: And Samuel did not yet know the LORD, and the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:8
segments: And the LORD called Samuel again, the third time. And he arose and went to Eli and said, Here [am] I, for you called me. And Eli saw that the LORD had called the child.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:9
segments: And Eli said to Samuel, Go, lie down; and it shall be, if [One] calls you, you shall say, Speak, LORD, for Your servant hears. And Samuel went to lie down in his place.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:10
segments: And the LORD came and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel! Then Samuel answered, Speak, for Your servant hears.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:11
segments: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it shall tingle.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:12
segments: In that day I will confirm to Eli all that which I have spoken as to his house, beginning and making an end.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:13
segments: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knows, because his sons made themselves vile and he did not restrain them.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:14
segments: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering forever.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:15
segments: And Samuel lay until morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to show Eli the vision.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:16
segments: And Eli called Samuel and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here [am] I.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:17
segments: And he said, What [is] the word which He has said to you? Please do not hide [it] from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide a thing from me of all the words that He said to you.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:18
segments: And Samuel told him all the words, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It [is] the LORD; let Him do what seems good to Him.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:19
segments: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:20
segments: And all Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, knew that Samuel [was] established to be a prophet of the LORD.

entries.title: I Samuel 3:21
segments: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh. For the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.
